desc_pm-kisan: A central sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs.
desc_pm-fby: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events.
desc_mudra-shishu: Collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹50,000 for micro enterprises and small business start-ups.
desc_pmay-urban: Credit linked subsidy scheme for affordable housing acquisition or construction for economically weaker sections and lower income groups.
desc_ayushman-pmjay: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing free secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
desc_standup-india: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprise.
desc_national-scholarship: Financial assistance for meritorious students belonging to OBC, SC, ST, and minority categories pursuing post-secondary studies.
desc_udyam-msme-subsidy: Capital investment and technology upgradation subsidy for registered MSMEs in IT, manufacturing, and food processing sectors.
desc_pm-svanidhi: Special micro-credit facility for street vendors to facilitate collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 with interest subsidy.
desc_pm-vishwakarma: Comprehensive support for traditional artisans and craftspeople including recognition, skill training, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit.
overview_pm-kisan: Under the PM-KISAN scheme, an income support of ₹6,000 per year is provided to all farmer families across the country in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each every four months directly into their bank accounts.
overview_pm-fby: PMFBY provides end-to-end insurance cover against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages for all food & oilseeds crops.
overview_mudra-shishu: Under the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana, Shishu loans cover loans up to ₹50,000 for small manufacturing units, service sector units, shopkeepers, and artisans.
overview_pmay-urban: PMAY(U) provides interest subsidy on home loans for purchase, construction, extension, or improvement of houses to eligible urban families.
overview_ayushman-pmjay: PM-JAY provides health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empaneled private hospitals.
overview_standup-india: The Stand-Up India scheme facilitates bank loans for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or the trading sector.
overview_national-scholarship: Provides maintenance allowance, course fees reimbursement, and book grants directly to eligible students' verified accounts.
overview_udyam-msme-subsidy: Offers up to 15% upfront capital subsidy on institutional finance availed for induction of well-established and improved technology in specified sub-sectors.
overview_pm-svanidhi: Aims to empower street vendors by not only extending loans to resume their livelihoods but also scaling up with repeat tranches and digital transaction incentives.
overview_pm-vishwakarma: Provides PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, basic & advanced skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant, and enterprise development loans at 5% interest.
